steps.title: Recording
steps.description: Each bank phone call (Swiss German) is processed on our own GPU; nothing leaves the bank.

steps.title: Speech to text
steps.description: A Whisper model fine-tuned on Swiss German writes a Standard German transcript with timestamps per segment.

steps.title: Who speaks
steps.description: Speaker turns are separated and labelled advisor or customer.

steps.title: Swiss German view (display only)
steps.description: A dialect speech model re-transcribes each segment so officers can read the original dialect; no decision reads it.

steps.title: Keywords and patterns
steps.description: The case's keyword list and number patterns mark candidate passages instantly.

steps.title: Two AI readers answer yes/no facts
steps.description: For every category, each reader answers small yes/no questions about the call with a probability. Both answers are stored.

steps.title: Combine the readers
steps.description: Each answer becomes yes / no / unclear with the certainty cutoff c; the two readers are combined per fact (Agreement by default).

steps.title: Rules decide
steps.description: Per category, the first matching rule of the compliance rule book decides alarm, review or no alert. Officers edit rules instantly; new facts need a second person.

steps.title: Score and label
steps.description: Rule outcomes and keyword evidence become a call score; the threshold and review band give the call label and the passages to listen to.

steps.title: Officer review
steps.description: The officer listens to the passages, confirms or corrects; every review is stored as a training data point and audit-logged.
